country: Low- and middle-income countries (not further specified)

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT diagnoses and medications, and unnecessary or harmful medications, in simulated patient cases
links.effect: Correct diagnoses 20/27 (74%); correct medication prescriptions 22/27 (82%); unnecessary or harmful medications 23/27 (85%) even with correct diagnoses.
links.quote: ChatGPT had a high level of accuracy in both correct diagnoses (20/27, 74%) and medication prescriptions (22/27, 82%) but a concerning level of unnecessary or harmful medications (23/27, 85%) even with correct diagnoses.

screen.reason: Evaluated ChatGPT's diagnostic and prescription safety using simulated patient clinical vignettes representing conditions in low- and middle-income countries without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
